technical_and_design_decisions: Migrate wiki documentation into the project repository using Markdown format for version control integration.
Implement Hadoop NameNode configuration via a properties or YAML config file loaded at application startup.
Refactor jdbchdfs batch job to support passthrough mode without chunk processing by introducing a flag or separate job configuration.
Decouple execution context from job launch lifecycle by leveraging Spring Batch's updated APIs post-upgrade.
Use Java Config-based job modules instead of XML configuration for custom job definitions.
Design a pluggable SPI for deployment targets with Receptor API as one implementation.
Update module documentation to include shortDescription field in metadata.
Implement HDFS-based Python script hosting and execution via shell processor integration.
assumptions: The project uses Spring Boot and Spring Batch 4.x or higher.
Developers have access to Hadoop cluster configurations and HDFS.
The team is familiar with Spring Framework and Java 17+.
Documentation updates are limited to existing modules and do not require new content creation.
Python scripts are executed in a remote Py runtime environment accessible from XD.
Wiki migration involves converting existing content into Markdown files within the repo.
All changes are tested in a local development environment before integration.

activities.activity_description: Convert and migrate existing wiki documentation into the project repository as Markdown files for versioning.
Implement configuration file support for Hadoop NameNode settings to auto-configure DSL sessions.
Modify jdbchdfs batch job to support passthrough mode without chunk processing overhead.

activities.activity_name: Decouple Execution Context from Job Launch
activities.activity_description: Refactor code to decouple execution context from job launch lifecycle and upgrade Spring Batch dependency.

activities.activity_name: Custom Job Module with Java Config
activities.activity_description: Create and deploy a custom job module using Java Config instead of XML, resolving deployment errors.
Design and implement a pluggable SPI for deployment targets with Receptor API as one implementation.
Update all module documentation to include shortDescription field for user reference.

activities.activity_name: Host and Execute Python Scripts from HDFS
activities.activity_description: Implement support for hosting Python scripts on HDFS and executing them via shell processor in XD.
